mapper.sql: select p.person_id, p.person_code, p.person_name, p.dept_id, p.user_id, u.user_name, u.status as user_status, d.dept_name, p.position_name, p.email, p.mobile, p.status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from pm_person p left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
and p.person_code like concat('%', #{personCode}, '%') and p.person_name like concat('%', #{personName}, '%') and (p.dept_id = #{deptId} or p.dept_id in ( select dept_id from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors))) and p.position_name like concat('%', #{positionName}, '%') and p.status = #{status}
order by p.person_id desc

where p.status = '0'
and (p.person_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.person_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.dept_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by p.person_name, p.person_id limit 100

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.status from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' and (u.status = '0' or u.user_id = (select user_id from pm_person where person_id = #{personId})) and not exists ( select 1 from pm_person p where p.user_id = u.user_id and (#{personId} is null or p.person_id <> #{personId}) )
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by u.user_name, u.user_id limit 100
mapper.insert: insert into pm_person(person_code, person_name, dept_id, user_id, position_name, email, mobile, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{personCode}, #{personName}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{positionName}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from pm_person where person_id in #{personId}
